facts.text: Maria recently gave talks at a homeless shelter and received compliments from other volunteers.

evidence.quote: I recently gave a few talks at the homeless shelter I volunteer at. It was really fulfilling and I received lots of compliments from other volunteers.

facts.text: Maria bought a cross necklace to feel closer to her faith, which made her happy.

evidence.quote: And, I bought a cross necklace to feel closer to my faith- which has made me happy.

facts.text: Maria organized a meal for shelter residents and helped with getting everything ready.

evidence.quote: We organized a meal for the shelter residents and I helped with getting everything ready.

facts.text: Maria shared a photo of a group of people standing around a table filled with food from last week.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic from last week. Seeing everyone come together warms my heart and fills me with hope.
